name: Komatsu Ryuunosuke
source:
Arcobaleno's owner.
He started the restaurant along with [url=/c42197]Nikichi[/url] using his grandfather's inheritance.
He actually has no skill in cooking, but he doesn't realize it himself.
A trouble maker that is always trying to come up with new menus and change the management policies, but that un-hateable personality of his is the restaurants specialty.
